description: This image is a false-colour satellite image depicting mountainous or undulating terrain in Nipfjället, Sweden, illustrating "Sparsely vegetated land" (CORINE Land Cover, CLC, class 6.1). The image features a mix of colours: light blue/cyan for the sparsely vegetated areas, reddish-brown for other vegetation or bare soil, and dark blue/black indicating shadows or rock faces in the upper and central parts. A prominent yellow oval highlights a central portion of the image, drawing attention to the characteristic appearance of sparsely vegetated areas, which in this context often occur in mosaics with heath vegetation, mire vegetation, alpine grassland, and willow bushes. The image is credited to S. Kirppu and serves as an example for land cover classification guidelines.
